object.attr: derived: the gate shares the history walk with the GUI and the MCP server, so a walk error reads OK everywhere; comparing the target at two commits is a second route that doesn't use the walk (CF-C24, CF-C25, CF-C50). A link this finds that the GUI shows OK is a gap in TRACE's rule.
object.description: If a link's target object or its figure differs between the link's acknowledged commit and the latest commit, mellon-check shall report the link as a suspect link.
